instruction.text: Select all the sentences that have been punctuated correctly.

b: ++If you’re free right now, can you lend me a hand?
If you’re free right now, you should lend me a hand?
If you’re free right now, I’d like you to lend me a hand?
++I’m free right now, so do you want me to lend you a hand?
++Did you really see them playing in the park instead of going to school?
I really saw them playing in the park instead of going to school?
Tell me if you really saw them playing in the park instead of going to school?
++Is it true that you saw them playing in the park instead of going to school?
++When will we be able to visit Aunt Yolanda again?
++Do you know when we will be able to visit Aunt Yolanda again?
We will be able to visit Aunt Yolanda in a few months?
++Will we be able to visit Aunt Yolanda again?
++Have you heard the rumour that Teddy is moving to Canada next week?
You have heard a rumour that Teddy is moving to Canada next week?
I don’t know if the rumour that Teddy is moving to Canada next week is true?
++What’s this rumour about Teddy moving to Canada next week?
++Once we’re back home, can I have an ice cream?
++Do you want an ice cream when we’re back home?
++Can I have an ice cream when we’re back home?
++Shall we have some ice cream when we’re back home?
++Can you promise me that we’ll see each other again one day?
I promise you that we’ll see each other again one day?
Please promise me that we’ll see each other again one day?
++Will you promise me that we’ll see each other again one day?
++How did you do so well on the test when you were so busy?
She did well on the test, even though she  had been really busy?
You did well on the test when you were so busy?
You were really busy, but you did so well on the test?
++Where did I leave my science textbook after doing my homework?
++Did I leave my science textbook somewhere after doing my homework?
++Do you remember where I left my science textbook after I did my homework?
I don’t remember where I left my science textbook after doing my homework?
